data.response_model: For a future batch at concentration c, each of m reads has response y_i=k*c+U+epsilon_i. The population blank response mean is exactly known as zero; there is no contemporaneous matched blank subtraction. U is a zero-mean Gaussian batch offset with the supplied shared standard deviation, constant across all m reads. Conditional read errors epsilon_i are mutually independent zero-mean Gaussian variables with variance sigma0^2+q*c, independent of U. Here k is response_slope, sigma0 is independent_blank_sd_response, and q is extra_independent_variance_per_mmol_l. All values are stipulated known prospective model parameters, not estimates from observed replicates.
data.decision_policy: For each protocol and m, call a signal detected when the arithmetic mean response is strictly above a blank threshold calibrated to the stated one-sided blank false-positive probability. Evaluate detection probability at the target concentration. First report the smallest statistically qualifying allowed read count for every protocol, ignoring costs at this stage; null means none of the allowed counts qualifies. Then choose the least total-cost statistically qualifying plan within cost_budget, with total cost fixed_cost+m*cost_per_read. Costs are positive per-read design units. Tie by lexical protocol ID, then lower m. Separately identify protocols unable to attain the required detection probability even with arbitrarily many reads, under this same shared-offset model.
data.probability_scope: False-positive and detection probabilities are marginal over future independent batch offsets and read errors under the stipulated Gaussian model. They are not conditional guarantees for every realized batch offset. The shared offset does not average down with read count. No empirical Gaussian validation, calibration uncertainty, drift, chemical selectivity or real method certification is established. Standard deviations and variances have different units and must not be interchanged.

source_provenance.kind: project-authored controlled prospective detector-design fixture, not laboratory readings or certified method limits
source_provenance.method_context: Known-parameter Gaussian mean and variance propagation with a shared random offset, normal tail calibration and discrete constrained design. New standard-normal tool provides probabilities only; no uncertainty model or scientific decision is delegated to it.
